author: FissuraZ
body:
Username: FissuraZ
Date of ban: January 6, 2016 at 9:16 PM
Reason of ban: Triggerbot

I am really sorry for triggerbotting on avicus and i really regret it. I hacked on avicus because i wanted to be good and gain some reputation from it. At that time i was very immature and actually felt good about hacking against good players. Then one day i was afk on the server and i forgot to turn my triggerbot off. I was lucky that jiveh and iron banned me for hacking because if they didn't ban me, i would continue to be immature and hack on every server i play. When i was banned, i couldn't play any games and because my macbook air doesn't support a lot of games and if it supports, either it gets like 10 fps or i crash every 2 minutes. Then, i remembered that i had an alt so i played on it then i eventually got banned on that account too. Now that i think about it i think i was really inconsiderate and immature and i hope i'll get unbanned although i don't deserve an unban. I promise i will not hack again, please give me one more chance.

title: Ban appeal

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your infraction, I've decided to deny your appeal. You indeed were using client-side modifications, which gave you an advantage over players, plus you ban evaded as you were perfectly aware of the rules, this gives us the impression that you certainly didn't care, and continued to violate rules. Needless to say, you appeal has been denied. You may appeal in 6-8 months.

Thanks!
